general.a: TiraiPlay is a metadata directory for Chinese short dramas. It helps you discover and browse series by genre and source platform, showing titles, synopses, episode counts and platform information. It does not stream video content.
Yes. Accessing and using TiraiPlay is free. It is a visual prototype that functions as a metadata directory, not a paid streaming service.

general.q: Where can I watch the listed dramas?
general.a: Each drama records its source platform (for example DramaBox, ReelShort or Anireels). Visit that platform to watch. TiraiPlay does not guarantee availability on any third-party platform.
TiraiPlay gathers metadata from public sources and tries to keep it accurate, but does not guarantee completeness. If you find a mistake, report it via the Contact page.

The website is available in English (EN) and Indonesian (ID); switch it from the language toggle in the navigation bar. Each episode also has its own Indonesian and English video, chosen on the watch page. Both choices are stored locally in your browser and need no login.

account.q: Do I need an account to use TiraiPlay?
account.a: No. Browsing, searching, and viewing metadata work without an account. Bookmarks are stored locally in your browser.

Hover a drama card and press the bookmark button in the preview to save it, or use the Bookmark button on its watch page. Bookmarks are stored in your browser’s local storage and are available across visits on the same device.
TiraiPlay only stores your website language, video language, theme and bookmarks locally in your browser via localStorage. No personal data is sent to a server. See the Privacy policy for details.

content.q: How do I search for a specific drama?
content.a: Use the search box in the header to type a title. You can also browse by genre, platform, or release schedule, or apply filters on the Browse page.

content.q: How can I see the latest dramas?
content.a: The homepage sections "Trending Now" and "Recently Updated" list recently added or updated titles. On the Browse page, use the "Newest" sort option.
Ratings shown in this prototype are illustrative demo values and are not independently verified. Treat them as a rough reference only.

content.q: How do I report a missing or incorrect drama?
content.a: Use the Contact page to report inaccurate metadata, duplicate titles, or dramas no longer available on their source platform.

legal.a: TiraiPlay is a metadata directory, not a streaming platform. It does not host or play video files. Rights to original material remain with their owners. See the DMCA policy for removal requests.

legal.q: Are there fees for content use?
legal.a: Using TiraiPlay to browse metadata is free. Watching on third-party streaming platforms may be subject to their own subscription fees.

legal.q: Where can I read the full terms?
legal.a: The full Terms of Service, Privacy policy and DMCA policy are available from the footer of every page.

technical.q: Why does the page not display correctly?
technical.a: Make sure you are using an up-to-date browser (Chrome, Firefox, Edge or Safari). Clearing your browser cache can also help.
Yes. TiraiPlay is responsive and adapts to mobile, tablet and desktop screens.

technical.q: Why does the video not play on TiraiPlay?
technical.a: TiraiPlay is not a streaming platform and does not provide a real video player. The watch page is a demo UI — follow the source platform to watch.

dmca.intro: TiraiPlay respects the intellectual property rights of all parties. This policy explains how to submit a copyright takedown request under the Digital Millennium Copyright Act (DMCA).
dmca.s1p1: This policy applies to all content identified on the platform, including drama titles, synopses, artwork and other metadata. TiraiPlay is a metadata directory — it does not host or play video files.
dmca.s1p2: If you are a content owner, or an authorised representative, and believe your copyrighted material is displayed on TiraiPlay without permission, the mechanism below lets you request removal.
dmca.s1note: Removal requests apply only to metadata shown on TiraiPlay, not to content on third-party streaming platforms where dramas are hosted.
dmca.s2p: To request removal, you (or your authorised representative) must send a written notice that meets the DMCA requirements to our designated copyright agent.
dmca.s2warn: Inaccuracy in a notice can result in liability for damages. If you are unsure whether material is infringing, consult a lawyer first.
